directives.name: default-src
directives.reason: Anything not listed below loads only from the Console origin.

directives.name: base-uri
directives.reason: The <base href> stays on the Console origin.

directives.name: script-src
directives.reason: Same-origin scripts only, no inline script; WASM for the .NET runtime and Cesium/MapLibre decoders; eval because the vendored Vega chart stack compiles expressions with Function().

directives.name: style-src
directives.reason: Razor components render style attributes and Vega/Studio inject <style> elements.

directives.name: img-src
directives.reason: Map tiles, sprites and thumbnails come from operator-chosen servers; MapLibre and Vega decode into data:/blob: URLs.

directives.name: font-src
directives.reason: Bundled fonts and data: glyphs embedded in vendored stylesheets.

directives.name: connect-src
directives.reason: The Honua API origin is chosen at deploy time (config.json apiBaseUrl), map sources are arbitrary HTTPS servers, and live operation updates use SignalR WebSockets.

directives.name: worker-src
directives.reason: Cesium workers load from the Console origin; MapLibre starts its worker from a blob: URL.

directives.name: frame-src
directives.reason: Only the bundled Studio style editor is framed.

directives.name: form-action
directives.reason: Forms submit to the Console origin; sign-in redirects are navigations, not form posts.

directives.name: frame-ancestors
directives.reason: The Console is never framed. Browsers ignore this directive in a <meta> policy.
